- Wi-Fi: the coverage map draws itself as you walk. In augmented reality (ARCore, plus the ToF infrared sensor when the phone has one), the dimmed camera shows the floor painted in small coloured tiles under your feet, just like WiFiman, with the -80 to -30 dBm scale and the network at the bottom; without ARCore, a step counter and the compass trace your path. Area, share of good signal and CSV export on demand
- GNSS: 5 new tools
  - Atomic clock: satellite UTC time to the millisecond, how far ahead or behind the phone is, GPS week, crystal drift
  - Compass and GNSS heading: the compass compared with the satellite heading while you walk
  - Sky mask: where the sky is blocked by obstacles, as a % of open sky
  - Jamming and spoofing: 8 indicators watched continuously to spot a jammer or fake signals
  - Raw measurements: dual frequency L1/L5, per-satellite signals and RINEX 3.04 export
- Bluetooth: each unknown tracker gets a drawing faithful to the real object (AirTag seen from the back with its apple and engraved text, Tile Mate, Galaxy SmartTag2, AirPods, iPhone, Google tag)
- README fully rewritten
